english.title: Driver of motor vehicle fail to give name / address to PC / T.Warden / examiner believed involved on accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[whom a traffic warden had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(E)_[whom a traffic warden had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(F)_[whom a vehicle examiner had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(G)_[whom a vehicle examiner had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a

(H)_[constable,]_
(I)_[traffic warden,]_
(J)_[vehicle examiner]_

failed to give your name and address
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For the comparable offence in relation to an accident only in a public place see H71.
(ii) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) The offence was extended to include 'other public place' by the The Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations 2000 - S.I. 726/2000 refers.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd modur yn methu rhoi enw/cyfeiriad i gwnstabl/warden traffig/archwilydd - mewn cysylltiad â damwain/trosedd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[yr oedd gan warden traffig achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(E)_[yr oedd gan warden traffig achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(F)_[yr oedd gan archwilydd cerbydau achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(G)_[yr oedd gan archwilydd cerbydau achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), ac y bu ichi, ar gais

(H)_[cwnstabl,]_
(I)_[warden traffig,]_
(J)_[archwilydd cerbydau,]_

fethu rhoi eich enw a'ch cyfeiriad
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[yn cael ei amau o yrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yn cael ei amau o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

Methodd y diffynnydd roi

(D)_[ei enw a'i gyfeiriad]_
(E)_[ei henw a'i chyfeiriad]_

i

(F)_[gwnstabl,]_
(G)_[warden traffig,]_
(H)_[archwilydd cerbydau]_

pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny.
